actions.action: Lift inner pot, empty cachepot water, test soil with chopstick and squeeze stem base
Water in sink only when chopstick is dry and pot is light, drain 15 minutes, return to cachepot
Cut mostly yellow stem at soil level with sterilized scissors

reason: The answer correctly names overwatering with possible stem rot and cuts watering frequency, but it never suggests repotting to check and save the roots, which was a key part of the confirmed fix; nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plant.
